proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly derives Bhojpuri/Awadhi manaī man and Hindi manaī man/husband/bridegroom from the *mānavika extension of mānava. These central and Terai forms match that documented manaī family, including nasalized and inflected variants; they are kept distinct from mānuṣa/mānis.
